references.text: The fulfillment of the promise: Sisera gathers his chariot forces at the Kishon River, just as God had foretold.
Deborah's song describes how the Kishon River swept away the enemies, confirming God's promise of victory.
The psalm refers to the victory over Sisera at the Kishon as an example of God's mighty intervention against enemies.
The book of Joshua mentions that Jabin was king in Hazor, providing background on whom Sisera served under.
The actual victory over Sisera and his army, fulfilling the promise that God would deliver him into Barak's hand.
Samuel mentions Sisera as an example of enemies God gave Israel victory over when they cried out to Him.
God's promise to 'draw' the enemy to a specific place recalls how God drew Pharaoh's army into the Red Sea.
